Swad Sagar Caterers — Vegetarian Wedding Catering, Ahmedabad

Swad Sagar is an Ahmedabad-based pure-vegetarian caterer specializing in
Gujarati and Rajasthani wedding menus, including elaborate farsan counters,
live jalebi-fafda stations, and traditional Gujarati thali service.

Their standard vegetarian wedding package is ₹1,050 per plate, with premium
multi-cuisine menus at ₹1,400 per plate. Live counters are included up to three;
additional counters are charged separately.

Contact: +91 99090 12233 · info@swadsagar.example
Location: Satellite, Ahmedabad, Gujarat
Rating: 4.6 / 5 (221 reviews)

What couples say:
"Authentic Gujarati flavors, exactly like home cooking but at scale."
"The farsan and chaat counters were a huge hit."
"Punctual setup and generous portions."

Swad Sagar is a popular choice for traditional Gujarati weddings and offers a
detailed tasting session for bookings above 300 guests.
